qwen38-27b-exl3-4bpw-vllm.use_for: A B70 builder on vLLM for the EXL3 4.00bpw safetensors. Served language-model only, prediction head present and unused, speculation off, ctx 100,000, host VRAM 28.15 GiB after the bench. The pinned intel vLLM image will not load this quant; serve uses this row's image. The engine log says kv_cache_dtype auto on dtype bfloat16, recorded here as kv bf16; the vLLM argv does not take a K/V quant flag. No llama.cpp host-buffer lines, so ram_gb_extra is 0. Prefill 1893.1 tok/s at 8184 tokens and 1320.6 tok/s at 98729 tokens. The only 128-token decode is 33.87 tok/s at depth 0. The 98729-token completion stopped after 12 tokens at 27.58 tok/s, so decode at 8k, 32k, 64k and 100k was not measured. useful_ctx is the served window, not the four-tokens-a-second figure, and the depth probe was not run. Reasoning was off in the engine. The chat template still emitted a think tag, and those tokens counted as output and were not capped. Kit 3/3: the counted JavaScript stage is a retest after the first JavaScript stage applied an empty patch; backend and optimise are the first run. A tool call parsed.
